description: This file defines an abstract class HTMLPurifier_Strategy, which serves as a base for classes implementing different token modification or purification strategies within the HTMLPurifier library. It provides a contract for executing strategies on a set of HTML tokens, utilizing configuration and context objects.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Strategy
classes.description: An abstract class that defines a strategy interface for processing HTML tokens within the HTMLPurifier filtering framework.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: An abstract method that should be implemented to modify or purify an array of HTML tokens, potentially using configuration and context information.
